design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. Delphine Iverson asks only to cancel the Northgate Protect plan on her laptop and get the refund. The Accident plan cancellation refund (plan_ext_accident_cancellation_refund; owner=user tool cancel_accident_plan_cec4ac7d, owner_ruling (a): the holder's own confirmed cancellation with its grouped refund) states 'The Accident plan cancellation refund is not worked out until every claim filed on the plan carries the administrator's decision.' and 'The Accident plan cancellation refund is fixed only after every claim approved on the plan before today carries a settlement.' At the opening the October accidental-damage claim has no decision and the September battery claim, approved on 2026-09-23, has no settlement. The repair authorization (plan_ext_repair_authorization_value) states 'The authorized repair value is fixed only after the covered item carries its limit-of-liability registration on the plan.'; the plan's remaining limit is 0.00 with no registration row, so the registration (plan_ext_limit_of_liability_registration) comes first. The decision (plan_ext_accident_claim_service_fee) states 'A claim decision is not recorded until every claim approved on the plan before today carries a settlement.', so it follows the repair. The cancellation rule states outright that a claim approved on the cancellation date keeps its fee among the fees still owed and is repaired after the cancellation, and the repair rule authorizes no repair on the day of an approval, so the October claim is not repaired in this call. Every edge is unmet at frozen_time on a seeded row.

SCOPE. Task 0 claims registration, repair, decision and the Accident refund with tools register_item_limit_ba116528, authorize_claim_repair_5d8df043, record_claim_decision_cf68f06d, cancel_accident_plan_cec4ac7d. Task 1 keeps the food-loss payment and the Standard refund (worklog D0: sibling cancellation policies over disjoint plan families).

DRAW. prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts [6,6,4,5]: repair 6, decision 6, registration 4, refund 5. Value_input edges: refund <- decision (fees owed, approvals), refund <- repair (payout share), repair <- registration (registered limit); state_gate decision <- repair.

FACTOR CARD (check_compute DSL; each figure is result with that factor at its baseline).
Registration 2322.48 (all-baseline 2149.99 = recorded net price): replacement_price_basis method, promotion line -> selling price 2349.99 (2122.48); competitor_match_reduction, online Best Buy match -> half of 100.00 (2372.48); accessory_allowance_rule multi-source, general-merchandise charging cable 19.99 (net line amount below the lowest plan price, so it cannot carry its own plan) over one electronics device line (2302.49); delivery_charge_share, Same-Day -> 0.75 x 9.99 shared over the order's three merchandise lines (2319.98). Near-miss: the household line on the same order (other category) and the laptop line itself (electronics class) are not accessories.
Repair 327.78 on the battery claim (all-baseline 99.00): repair_charge_method method, computer -> flat 99.00 scaled by registered limit / 1500 (273.50); parts_allowance_tier +60 (267.78); item_age_allowance 288 days +30 (297.78); service_call_charge depot +40 (287.78); inspection_charge_rule first repair after a late purchase +20 (307.78); return_label_charge +24.50 (303.28). Near-miss: the denied January claim and the undecided October claim are not the most recently approved claim.
Decision 46.75 on the October claim (all-baseline 49.00): starting_fee_method method, computer -> 0.025 x 2149.99 (42.00); prompt_report_credit 15 off (61.75); repeat_claim_step two other claims +20 (26.75); long_term_credit 1096 days 5 off (51.75); late_purchase_surcharge +5 (41.75); plan_price_credit 12 off (58.75).
Refund 216.07 (all-baseline 217.08): coverage_count_start method, bought after fulfilment -> 1066 coverage days (207.53); payout_weighting_rule light tier (231.22); held_months_fee 9 months -> 15.00 (205.57); claim_administration_charge two approvals 15.00 (231.82); late_handling_addition 11-day request 5% (205.78). Near-miss: the withdrawn August request (81 days, would take the slow-handling rate) is excluded by its status; the January decision's fee window is past.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. full_refund_window (anchor purchase_date 2025-12-28; +30 calendar days, last day 2026-01-27 qualifies): on 2026-10-23 with claims filed the prorated basis applies. refund_once: the only charge has no refund and was paid by external card, which the cancel tool requires. plan_claim_eligibility for the October claim: covered peril, inside the term and after the waiting period, filed day 1 of 30, plan active, one approval in the rolling 12 months against a limit of 2. plan_claim_settlement: repair value below 80% of the recorded net price, so repair.

BUSINESS OBJECT. Plan 9e77406e... covers order line 836309ff... of order fc399711... (order number 3417702659). Registration: that line, the charging-cable line, the same-day fee, the competitor match; excluded: the household line. Repair: battery claim (approval dated 2026-09-23). Decision: October claim. Refund: charge 3a44e84b... to the external card.

SEED. Order priced by order.yaml (promotion before the net amount, 9.99 same-day fee for a non-member, competitor price match to a listed competitor within 14 days refunded as net unit price less the lower price, one adjustment per line). Plan recorded at the net price paid; no registration; January claim denied for the waiting period; battery claim approved and unsettled; October claim undecided; August request withdrawn; October request waiting.

PERSONA. Clipped engineer relocating to Germany; volunteers only the cancellation, the October app request and the reason; identity details on request; claims, fee and coverage limit only as passive reactions; she completes the cancellation herself at the hand-over.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify (phone, DOB) -> find_plan_holdings -> find_plan_events -> find_plan_requests -> find_order_holdings -> find_order_events -> register 2322.48 -> authorize repair of the battery claim 327.78 -> decide the October claim approved 46.75 -> hand over cancellation (plan, charge, prorated_unused_days, 216.07).

TRAPS. Registering at the recorded net price; taking the whole competitor match off; repairing the October claim today; counting the household line; deciding before the battery claim is settled; using the band fee; counting coverage from 2025-12-06; using the withdrawn request; rounding the refund half up.

VERIFICATION. All per-task gates rerun in rework round 5 (worklog.md). Skip sensitivity: without the decision the refund is 273.03, without the repair 231.22, without the registration the repair value is 0.00.
user_scenario: You are Delphine Iverson, a forty-six-year-old project engineer from Edmond, Oklahoma, calling Northgate's care line on a weekday morning between meetings. You are organized and a little clipped, but polite. Your company is sending you to its office in Stuttgart, Germany for a two-year assignment starting in mid-November, so you are cancelling things you will not use. You open by saying you want to cancel the Northgate Protect plan on your Corvane laptop and get whatever refund is due back on the card you paid with; you mention that you already asked to cancel it in the Northgate app on October 12 and nothing seems to have happened. You authorize the agent to look into your plan and do whatever has to be done on their side today, and you will do the cancellation yourself if they hand it to you. You do not know how the refund is worked out and you do not volunteer anything about claims, repairs or registrations. When the agent asks who you are, you give your mobile number 4055550126; if they ask for a second detail you give your date of birth, June 14, 1980 (1980-06-14). If they ask for your email it is delphine.iverson@outlook.com and your billing ZIP is 73034. If the agent asks which order the laptop came from, you only remember it came by same-day delivery on December 6 last year and that you added the plan by phone a few weeks later; you do not have order or plan numbers handy and ask them to look it up. If the agent asks about the August request, you say you started a cancellation then but changed your mind the same week. If the agent brings up the battery claim from September, you say the battery had started swelling, you were told it was approved, and you want that repair to go ahead before you leave. If the agent brings up the laptop claim you reported in October, you say yes, you dropped it on October 6 and the screen cracked, and you agree to the agent sorting out whatever the claims need first. If the agent explains that a service fee will be taken out of your refund, you say that is fine. If the agent explains that the screen repair for the October claim will be set up after the cancellation, you say that works and you will ship the laptop when the instructions arrive. If the agent says something about the plan's coverage limit needing to be put on the record first, you tell them to go ahead. When the agent tells you the refund amount, you accept it without arguing and say you never expected much back. When the agent hands you the cancellation to complete yourself, you run it exactly with the plan reference, the charge reference, the refund basis and the refund amount the agent gives you, and then read back the confirmation you get. Once the agent confirms the plan is canceled and the refund is on its way to your card, you thank them, say good luck with the rest of the queue, and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The order is a chain fixed by the prerequisite sentences: the repair waits on the registration, the decision waits on the repair of the earlier approved claim, and the refund waits on the decision and the repair. No two writes are free to swap.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the decision row the claim service fees still owed fall to nothing and the claims approved to one, so the refund would be 273.03 instead of 216.07.
Without the repair settlement the payout share is zero and the refund would be 231.22 instead of 216.07; the settlement row is also missing from the terminal state.
State gate: the decision may not be recorded while the earlier approved claim lacks its settlement; skipping the repair leaves that settlement row missing from the terminal state.
Without the registration the limit of liability registered on the plan is zero, the remaining share is zero and the authorized repair value would be 0.00 instead of 327.78.
